name: start-first-client-proposal
description: Writes a First Client Proposal of one or two pages, with their objective in their words, what you will do by phase, one to three real options that differ in scope, the fee from your own numbers, the assumptions it rests on, plain terms and a dated next step. Use for "run start-first-client-proposal", "write my first proposal", "consulting proposal for a first client", "they asked for a proposal", "turn my call notes into a proposal", "how do I present my price", "short proposal with options", part of the Claude Guide for New Founders Pack by 90n.
